_comment: OPTIONAL TOOL PARAMETERS, declared as SCHEMA instead of only as prose. Every tool's `@tool(...)` third argument lists only its REQUIRED params, and both schema builders (harness/mcp_server.py and harness/openai_backend.py) therefore emitted `required: [everything declared]` plus `additionalProperties: true` — so the 48 optional arguments the handlers actually read (`args.get("passive")`, `args.get("free_only")`, `args.get("mode")` …) existed NOWHERE in the schema. They were documented only inside the tool's description paragraph. A strong model infers them from that prose reliably; a mid-size open-weight model largely does not, and the failure is expensive rather than loud — on a hostile run it never passes `passive=true`, on a budget run it never passes `free_only=true`, so the tool-call gate correctly DENIES the call and the run burns turns looping instead of adapting. Declaring these here fixes it for every front-end at once, and the `enum` lists matter most: a model that cannot see that `mode` accepts exactly six values will invent a seventh. THIS FILE ADDS NO CAPABILITY — every parameter below is already read by its handler; it only makes the existing contract visible. When you add an optional `args.get("x")` to a handler, add it here too, or it stays invisible to the model. Types must match how the handler parses the value: `seeds`, `victims` and `paths` are SPACE-OR-COMMA-SEPARATED STRINGS, not arrays, because that is what the handler splits.

optional_params._comment: One entry per tool name, mapping optional parameter -> {type, description, enum?, required?}. `type` is a JSON Schema primitive (string|integer|number|boolean). `description` is one line the model reads at call time — write it as an instruction, not a definition. `enum` pins the accepted values where the handler branches on a fixed set; omit it for free-form values. An entry may also name a param the `@tool` schema already declares (it then adds the description/enum); `"required": false` on such an entry drops it from the schema's `required` list, for a declared param the handler actually defaults (kb_query_shared.min, reverse_whois.kind). EVERY key a handler reads from args must be declared either in its `@tool` schema or here — intel_engine/tests/test_mcp_protocol.py fails on an undeclared one. A tool absent from this map simply has no optional parameters.

passive.description: Do NOT fetch the target directly; reconstruct from Wayback/urlscan instead. REQUIRED on hostile infrastructure — a direct fetch puts the analyst's own IP on attacker logs.

proxy.description: Route the fetch through this proxy URL (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080). Use with, or instead of, passive on hostile targets.

force.description: Re-collect even if a pivot JSON for this host already exists. Default false = reuse the cached collection.

no_assets.description: Skip the JS/CSS asset layer (bundle hashes, sourcemap dev identity, well-known files). Cheaper, but drops the build-machine pivots.

no_well_known.description: Skip robots.txt / sitemap.xml / ads.txt / security.txt retrieval only.

assets_max.description: Cap how many JS/CSS bundles are downloaded. Lower this when the target is slow or you are rate-limited.

no_docmeta.description: Skip the document/image metadata layer. It costs extra requests TO THE TARGET, so disable it when minimising footprint.

docmeta_max.description: Cap how many hosted PDFs/images are downloaded for metadata extraction.

free_only.description: Run only keyless layers; hold every metered lookup (FOFA, urlscan Pro, WhoisXML …). Set this on a no-spend posture or when the gate asks you to re-call with free_only=true.

proxy.description: Route the page fetch through this proxy (research egress). Use on hostile targets.

no_crawl.description: Do not follow the one hop to the linked register/login page.

case.description: Also write the result to cases/<case>/engage/forms.json (the fill plan engage_account reads).
Persist the persona under cases/<case>/engage/ (recommended for evidence + traceability).

email_domain.description: A disposable inbox domain YOU control, so an email-verifying signup can be confirmed. Without it the email is a non-deliverable .invalid placeholder.

with_phone.description: Include a reserved non-routable placeholder phone. A real SMS-OTP still needs an analyst-provisioned number.

seed.description: Deterministic persona for a reproducible re-run with the SAME identity (do not touch the operator twice with two identities).

country.description: Country for the persona's address block (default US).

persona.description: Path to a make_persona JSON. MUST be synthetic (kind starts with 'synthetic') or the call is refused.

detection.description: Path to a detect_login JSON — the registration fill plan and the login form.

case.description: cases/<case>/engage/ for screenshots, the authenticated DOM and the audit ledger.

proxy.description: Research egress (VPS/VPN). Without this, and without allow_direct_egress, engagement is REFUSED — a signup from your own IP is a self-identifying beacon.

allow_direct_egress.description: Proceed from your own IP anyway. Only when the analyst accepts the attribution.

await_confirm.description: Email-gated signup: after registering, fetch the confirm link from the persona's puppet inbox (en_inbox) and click it before login. Needs a persona minted --from-pool.

target_domain.description: Domain to match the confirmation email against, so an unrelated message in the puppet inbox is not mistaken for it.

no_login.description: Register only; do not log in or harvest.

confirm.description: Explicit per-engagement approval. WITHOUT it the tool returns only the risk briefing and creates NO account. The run must ALSO have INTEL_ENGAGE_CONFIRM=1 (an agent cannot set that for itself).

base_url.description: Resolve relative form actions (the harvester upload path) against this URL.

case.description: Append the harvest findings to cases/<case>/engage/interactions.jsonl.

append_to.description: Append the rendered Panel Engagement section to this markdown file (e.g. cases/<case>/assessment.md); omit to return it as text.

case.description: Classify from this case's ALREADY-COLLECTED pivot JSON instead of probing. Sends no packet to the target — use this on hostile infrastructure.

offline.description: Classify from any cached collection of this host, in any case, instead of probing live.

timeout.description: Per-request timeout in seconds for the live probe.

fofa.description: Also validate candidates against FOFA. Spends FOFA credits; the default crt.sh + DNS sweep is free.

urlscan.description: Also validate candidates against urlscan. Spends urlscan quota.

max.description: Cap the number of generated lookalike candidates.

case.description: Case to write the artifact analysis into.

keep.description: Directory to retain the downloaded artifact in instead of discarding it after analysis.

max_domains.description: Refuse the reverse if it would return more than this many domains — a huge result is a shared/bulk registrant, i.e. NOISE, not one operator. Default: rwhois_auto_cap in harness/references/reverse_whois.json (150 unless an analyst changed it).

confirm.description: Override the max_domains gate and run anyway. Only set this after judging that the large result really is one operator.

free_only.description: Return only the free PREVIEW count and never purchase the domain list. Set this on a no-spend posture or when the gate asks for free_only=true.

mode.description: Which Censys operation to run. 'budget' is OFFLINE and free; 'cert'/'host'/'webproperty' are 1-credit lookups; 'search' costs 5 and needs Starter+; 'query' only BUILDS CenQL and spends nothing.

kind.description: For mode='query': the pivot artifact kind to build a CenQL query for (favicon, jarm, cert, …).

port.description: For mode='webproperty': the port of the web property to look up. Default 443.

free_only.description: Report the capability of a run that spends NO API credits. Use this to see what a keyless/free collection can and cannot reach before you start.

mode.description: 'check' reports drift between duplicated reference groups; 'repair' propagates the canonical copy over its mirrors.

'search' runs the selector across leak/stealer-log/paste/darknet buckets; 'phonebook' inventories a domain's emails and subdomains; 'item' OPENS one search record (selector = its storageid, plus `bucket`) as a bounded, redacted preview — the only thing an infection/compromise claim may cite; 'budget' is an OFFLINE quota check.

logs_only.description: Query ONLY the stealer-log buckets. IntelX returns a bounded page, so recycled public-breach rows otherwise fill it and truncate the one log record away.

buckets.description: mode=search: comma list of IntelX buckets to search, e.g. leaks.logs,pastes. Omit for the plan default.

target.description: mode=phonebook: which record type to list.

deadline.description: mode=search: overall wall-clock seconds for the whole search (default proportional to buckets searched). On expiry the records so far return with status 'partial (deadline)'.

bucket.description: mode=item: the record's `bucket` (e.g. leaks.logs), from the search records/read_these row.

lines.description: mode=item: preview lines (default from references/intelx.json result_limits.preview_lines).

systemid.description: mode=item: the record's systemid, used only for the intelx.io UI link.

mode.description: 'analyze' extracts the kit/template identifiers from one URL; 'patterns' reports one kit seen on N DISTINCT hosts across the case.

paths.description: Space- or comma-separated URLs/paths to analyse together.

min_hosts.description: mode=patterns: a path must recur on at least this many hosts to be reported as a kit.

mode.description: 'advertiser' looks up the Ads Transparency advertiser + funder; 'serp' reads the live ads block; 'params' classifies ad parameters in a URL; 'cloak' runs the FREE click-keyed cloaking probe (plain vs ad-click vs control).

region.description: Two-letter region code to scope the ads query to.

ad_params.description: mode=cloak: the ad's own parameters — a full landing URL or 'k=v&k=v' — replayed as an ad click.

details.description: mode=advertiser/creatives: also open N creatives for their destination link (extra searches).

gl.description: mode=serp: country of the search, e.g. vn.

dir.description: Re-hash and VERIFY an existing capture directory instead of capturing anew — this is the tamper check.

verify.description: Verify the capture manifest's hashes rather than writing a new capture.

third_party.description: Include third-party assets in the capture. They get a small byte allowance; anything dropped is listed in skipped_for_budget.

outdir.description: Explicit output directory (overrides the case layout).

mode.description: 'lookup' queries TI Lookup for others' detonations; 'history' lists YOUR OWN past tasks; 'report' fetches one task's report. An empty TI result means 'not entitled or not seen', never 'nothing known'.

iocs.description: Space- or comma-separated indicators to look up.

limit.description: Cap the number of returned records.

query.description: A raw TI Lookup query string; overrides the query built from `indicator`.

days.description: Only consider tasks from the last N days.

kind.description: Whether the target is a URL to visit or a file to detonate.

confirm.description: Explicit per-submission approval. WITHOUT this the tool only returns a risk briefing and sends NOTHING — submission is outbound, attributable and irreversible, and a URL detonation tells the operator they are being sandboxed.

allow_public.description: Permit a submission whose result would be PUBLIC. Refused by policy in almost every case; a free plan makes the task public to everyone.

allow_unverified_plan.description: Analyst attestation that this key is on a PAID sandbox plan. Only relevant when the engine cannot settle it from the account record (/user limits.private, then a prior private task in history); a zero private quota is DENIED regardless of this flag. Set ONLY when the analyst has explicitly said so — never on your own, never to get past a refusal. The applied privacy is still read back after the POST.

verify_task.description: Follow-up mode: `target` is a task UUID from an earlier submission whose result said privacy_verified=null. Reads the privacy ANY.RUN actually applied once the task has finished and withdraws a task that landed in a forbidden mode. Nothing is submitted.

wait.description: With verify_task: seconds to keep polling for the task to finish before giving up (default 0 = a single read).

privacy.description: Who can see the task. owner (default) is the only safe-by-construction choice; public is refused unless allow_public is set.

tags.description: ANY.RUN user tags — NEVER put a case id or an analyst/client name here.

confirm.description: Explicit per-submission approval. WITHOUT this the tool only returns the risk briefing and sends NOTHING — a Webamon scan lands in the PUBLIC searchable corpus permanently (no private mode, no delete) and the operator sees a datacenter visit.

wait.description: Seconds to poll for the scan to be indexed (~5 min typical; capped at 240). A still-pending result returns the report_id for `wp_webamon.py report <id>` later — nothing is re-submitted.

keep_query.description: Submit the URL WITH its query string/fragment. Default false: they are stripped because on a phishing link that is where the victim identifier or one-time token lives, and the Webamon corpus is public and permanent. Set ONLY when the analyst has explicitly decided the full URL may be disclosed.

min.description: Only report clusters with at least this many members.

max_prevalence.description: Ignore an indicator shared by more than this many domains — above it, the indicator is shared infrastructure, not an operator link. Default 8.

all.description: Include clusters that the prevalence and noise filters would otherwise suppress.

json.description: Return machine-readable JSON instead of the analyst-readable summary.

max_new.description: Cap how many new seeds the frontier proposes.

max_rounds.description: Cap the collect→assess→expand rounds before handing back to the analyst.

max_new.description: Cap how many new seeds each round may add.

seeds.description: First run / added evidence: a domains-file path or a comma list of seeds. Omit to RESUME.

free_only.description: Hold every metered leg (email-deep, IntelX, Hudson Rock, reverse-WHOIS) as an open lead; run only free legs. ChongLuaDao is unlimited and runs regardless. Held leak vendors are reported as not_consulted in leak_coverage.json. Use to avoid spending credits.

passive.description: Egress posture for hostile infrastructure; restricts direct target contact only. It does NOT hold spend — pair with free_only to avoid credits.

reopen_legacy.description: Reopen old held/unavailable closures that lack runner evidence and cannot be told apart from a deliberate analyst closure. Off by default.

leak_only.description: Run only the leak/stealer fan-out (CLD, IntelX, Hudson Rock, deep_profile) on the case's confirmed selectors and rewrite enrichment/leak_coverage.json. Same spend gate as a full run.

seeds.description: Space- or comma-separated additional seeds to reopen the case with.

case.description: Case id to use/create. Omit to derive one from the target.

quick.description: One collection pass only; leave enrichment and the chase loop OPEN for a later run. Mutually exclusive with deep/passive.

deep.description: Maps onto the loop step's own --full (metered engines) and --deep-archive, plus a deeper expansion --depth, instead of a single free-only pass. Mutually exclusive with quick/passive.

passive.description: No live contact with the target; skip the chase loop entirely. Mutually exclusive with quick/deep.

free_only.description: Spend no metered credits anywhere in the run.

extend.description: Continue even though recall already found a confirmed prior attribution for this target.

pipeline.description: Run the deterministic pipeline synchronously instead of the default cross-type harness loop (which starts in the background).

quarry.description: Wait for the Quarry scan before any pivot. Ask the user first when QUARRY_ENABLED=ask. Backgrounds the run; the wait can take hours or days and resumes if interrupted.

no_quarry.description: Do not use Quarry for this case, whatever QUARRY_ENABLED says.

start.description: Start a scan when Quarry has none. Crawls the target and spends the shared vendor accounts — ask the user first. Refused on a no-spend or no-contact case, and inside a harness phase.

wait_minutes.description: How long this call waits for the scan (default 20). The job is persisted; call again to resume the same wait instead of scanning twice. The unbounded wait belongs to the cti driver.

free_only.description: Reuse a finished scan only — never start one.

victims.description: Space- or comma-separated victim hostnames to profile the access vector from.

exclude.description: Comma list of hosts to leave out of the victim set (e.g. the operator's own domains).

history.description: Space-separated wayback_ga.py JSON paths to fold historical analytics into the timeline.

markdown.description: Emit the timeline as markdown for direct inclusion in an assessment.

no_figure.description: Skip rendering the swimlane figure; produce the evidence ledger only.

lang.description: Language of the generated figure furniture.

max_certs.description: Newest N certs drawn per host (default 12); the rest are counted, not hidden.

max_lanes.description: Max hosts drawn in the figure (default 24).

legend.description: Include the relationship legend in the rendered diagram.

no_render.description: Emit the editable Mermaid source only, without rendering PNG/SVG.

lang.description: Language for the GENERATED furniture (cover, TOC, captions). The body is never machine-translated.

report_ref.description: EXTERNAL report reference shown on the cover/header — must differ from the internal case id (OPSEC). Auto-minted if omitted.

audience.description: Reader profile — stamps the cover subtitle and sets TOC depth (le = law enforcement).

case_id.description: INTERNAL case id — only a fallback for the displayed reference; prefer report_ref for shared reports.

host.description: Only artifacts collected from these hosts (space- or comma-separated). Omit for the whole case.

info.description: The event headline the receiving analyst reads. Never put a case id, an analyst name or a local path in it — the export refuses those.

label.description: One word for the default headline (phishing, fraud, malware-delivery…).

tlp.description: TLP tag governing redistribution. Pick what the SOURCE of the material allows, not what is convenient.

confidence.description: The ICD-203 term from the assessment; becomes an estimative-language tag so the confidence travels with the indicators.

distribution.description: The audience to REQUEST (0 org · 1 community · 2 connected · 3 all · 4 sharing group). Recorded only — the push still stages at 0 and only misp_publish applies it.

analysis.description: 0 Initial · 1 Ongoing · 2 Completed. Claiming Completed on a case still collecting is a statement about OUR work.

include_review.description: Release ALL held-back values at once — personal data included. Prefer review_value: the analyst approves personal data value by value, not in bulk.

review_value.description: Approve specific held-back values (space- or comma-separated). This is the per-value decision the review class exists for.

type.description: Restrict to one MISP attribute type (domain, sha256, ip-dst, url…).

case.description: Stage the case's newest export and record the share in cases/<case>/misp/ledger.jsonl.

event_file.description: Path to a specific exported event JSON, instead of the case's newest.

event_id.description: Update this existing MISP event instead of creating a new one.

confirm.description: The analyst said yes to staging THIS event. WITHOUT it the tool returns only the briefing and sends nothing. Working a case is not consent to share it.

dry_run.description: Print the exact request that would be sent and send nothing — inspectable even with no instance configured.

publish.description: After staging, also PUBLISH (share it). Requires the analyst's yes to sharing AND env INTEL_MISP_PUBLISH=1 — without the lock the event stays staged and the result says so. This is one command for two decisions, never a way around the second one.

distribution.description: Audience used only when publish=true: 1 this community · 2 connected communities · 3 all communities · 4 a named sharing group. Ask the analyst which; do not pick for them.
Audience: 1 this community · 2 connected communities · 3 all communities (treat as public) · 4 a named sharing group. Ask the analyst which; do not pick for them.

sharing_group_id.description: Required when distribution is 4 — without it neither MISP nor you knows the real audience.

confirm.description: The analyst said yes to SHARING this event at this level. The run must ALSO have INTEL_MISP_PUBLISH=1, which an agent cannot set for itself.

dry_run.description: Print the requests that would be sent and send nothing.

mode.description: email runs the full profile. breach is the same keyed sends without the subdomain step. Do not run both on one email — they bill the same vendors.

case.description: Case directory. Sets WP_CASE_DIR so a second IntelX or reverse-WHOIS call hits the memo instead of buying the search again.

free_only.description: Hold every metered send (Hudson Rock, ZoneCruncher, IntelX, reverse-WHOIS). Use on a no-spend posture.

op.description: cld_api subcommand. Default route, which fires only the endpoints that match the selector.

free_only.description: Do not call ChongLuaDao. Return HELD. Set this on a no-spend posture.

host.description: Check one collected host instead of every host in the case.

json.description: Return the raw structure (verdict, ran, gaps) instead of the readable report.

status.description: Read the running/finished job's progress from its state file instead of starting it. No network, no spend.

max_hours.description: Run budget in hours for the detached job (default 7; 0 = unbounded). The job saves state and stops; call again to resume.

case.description: Case id — store the job's state under cases/<case>/deep-archive/ and read the registration date from the case WHOIS sidecar.

yfrom.description: Earliest capture date (YYYY or YYYYMMDD) to bound the sweep to one era.

created.description: Override the domain's current registration date (YYYY-MM-DD) used to split prior-owner selectors.

html_only.description: Skip archived JS/JSON; HTML captures only.

exits.description: Comma list of egress routes: direct,pool,socks5h://host:port. Default: the reference list.

state.description: Explicit state-file path (to resume or check a specific job).

free_only.description: Hold metered routes (FOFA, PublicWWW, rwhois purchase, anyrun, email-deep keyed sends) and force urlscan onto the keyless path. Use on a no-spend posture.

origin_type.description: Selector type the pivot started from (domain/email/phone/wallet/ip/hash/string/filename/telegram). Defaults to string. Owner edges are drawn FROM this origin.

origin_value.description: Selector value the pivot started from. Defaults to query. Pass the bare selector (not the Lucene field query) so KB edges attribute correctly.

confirm.description: Omit/false = return the BRIEFING (proposal table) only. true = record the analyst's decision — only after they named the ids.

only.description: Comma-separated proposal ids the analyst approved.

all.description: Approve every item in the pending proposal (only when the analyst said so).

reject.description: Comma-separated proposal ids the analyst rejected.

max_repos.description: Cap how many repositories are read (default 30).

max_contributors.description: Cap how many contributors are sampled per repository (default 10).

patches.description: Set false to skip fetching <commit>.patch files — faster, but loses the git author e-mail, which is the point of this tool. Default true.

free_only.description: Use keyless providers only — do not let subfinder spend metered keys. Applied automatically when the case scope says no_spend.

engines.description: Comma list of search engines to build/run queries for. Omit for the tool's default set.

run.description: Actually EXECUTE the queries (SerpApi fallback may spend credits). Default false = only emit the queries.

free_only.description: With run=true: use keyless engines only, never the metered SerpApi fallback.

max_queries.description: With run=true: cap how many queries are executed.

min.description: Minimum number of domains an indicator must be shared by to be listed (default 2).

case.description: Case id the fingerprint was learned from — keeps the provenance of a 'signal' entry.

note.description: Free-text note stored with the reference entry (why it is benign / why it matters).

case.description: Scope the report to this case id.

since.description: Only count calls on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

last.description: Also list the N most recent metered calls.

target_class.description: What the analyst believes the target is. Decides the fetch posture, the layers and whose artifacts these are.

purpose.description: What the run is for — e.g. triage, cluster expansion, attribution, takedown package, own-exposure check.

claim.description: What the requester asserted about the target, verbatim — the claim this run TESTS.

basis.description: What the belief rests on — victim complaint, takedown notice, vendor report, served ad, log entry, hunch.

brand.description: Brand, company or person being impersonated or targeted, and which side of it this host is.

how.description: How the target reached the analyst — ad/sponsored result, message/DM, download, redirect chain, referral from another case.

window.description: The date or date range that matters (incident, ad run, report publication).

falsifier.description: The result that would show the target is NOT what is believed — what would make the analyst drop it.

no_direct_contact.description: Record that the target must not be contacted from analyst egress (passive collection only).

no_spend.description: Record that no metered API credits may be spent on this case.

case.description: Read this case's ledger. Omit for the interactive MEMORY ledger.

denied.description: Show only the calls the gate BLOCKED, with the reason.

since.description: Only calls on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

last.description: List the N most recent calls.

username.description: The subject is a handle, not a person's name.

verify.description: Keyless corroboration: MX check per domain + Gravatar existence per address. Never probes the target's mail server.

free.description: Also permute against common free-mail providers (high noise — opt-in).

order.description: Name order; auto detects family-first VN/CN/KR surnames.

mode.description: origin (default) = recover origin IPs for a domain's cert; cert = which IPs served a sha1; ip = certs seen on an IP; budget = offline quota check.

subject.description: mode=cert: the certificate subject, used for the CDN base-rate check.

sha1.description: mode=origin: use this leaf-cert sha1 instead of a live handshake (no packet to the target).

known_ips.description: mode=origin: comma list of IPs already known to front the host (CDN edges) — excluded from origin candidates.

case.description: Write the screenshot under cases/<case>/evidence/screenshots/ and record it in the case manifest.

outdir.description: Explicit output directory (overrides the case layout).

proxy.description: Research egress (http://host:port) — use on hostile infrastructure.

label.description: Short caption stored with the capture.

click.description: Before capturing, click the first element whose text contains this string (splash/enter gates) and re-wait.

wait_selector.description: Wait for this CSS selector to appear before capturing.

wait_after.description: Final settle time in seconds after load/click before the shot.

verify.description: Re-hash an existing PNG/manifest given in `url` instead of capturing.

full_page.description: Set false to capture only the viewport, not the whole scrolled page. Default true.

host.description: Limit the history to this one host of the case.

sha1.description: Pivot on this leaf-cert sha1 fingerprint instead of fetching the live cert.

sha256.description: Pivot on this leaf-cert sha256 fingerprint instead of fetching the live cert.

serial.description: Hex x509 serial of the leaf cert for the FOFA cert.sn query (sent as decimal). Use only a real serial (crt.sh/certkit/netlas or the live leaf); surrogate ids from other CT indexes match nothing.

no_live.description: No live contact with the target or hit IPs (same as passive).

passive.description: Passive posture: CT + third-party indexes only; the leaf fetch and the Host-header origin probe read `not run`. Required under hostile posture unless a proxy is given.

proxy.description: Route every live contact (leaf cert, page baseline, Host-header probe of hit IPs) through this proxy URL.

cap.description: Max results per active pivot query (default 20).

min_strength.description: Only report pairs whose summed strength is at least this (default 1).

include_weak.description: Also list pairs linked only by weak artifacts.

md.description: Emit a markdown table instead of the plain view.

findings.description: Path to a findings JSON to rank selectors from.

emails.description: Comma list of e-mail addresses to rank.

names.description: Comma list of person names to rank.

domains.description: Comma list of domains to rank.

platform.description: auto (default): instagram.com URLs and @handles = Instagram, everything else = Facebook.

search.description: Ad Library page-name search: candidate Pages (id + names) whose ads match this name.

no_wayback.description: Skip the Wayback name/bio/location history pass.

no_linked.description: Do not follow the Page's linked Instagram account.

severity.description: Only emit queries at this severity.

domain.description: Domain whose ICP filing to look up.

serial.description: An ICP licence serial you already hold — reversed into sibling-domain queries.

company.description: A company name you already hold.

store.description: auto (default): numeric/idNNN or apps.apple.com = App Store, else Play package. appstore with a dotted value = iOS bundle id.

case.description: Case id — its collected domains scope the developer-website owner-link check.

case_domains.description: Comma-separated extra case domains for the owner-link check.

case.description: Only report identifiers appearing in this case (and at least one other).

min_cases.description: An identifier must appear in at least this many cases (default 2).

snapshot.description: Store the current state as a snapshot and exit; diff against it after the next collection.

against.description: Explicit snapshot file to diff against (default: the latest stored snapshot).

list.description: Show the signature catalogue and the observation keys it accepts.

refresh.description: Force a re-download of the cached sellers.json even when it is within its TTL.
